svg.text: The layout of a tiled copy: which thread copies which 16 bytes of a 64 × 64 tile of K

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: The block's 128 threads (4 warps × 32 threads) as a 16 × 8 grid: thread = 8 · row + 1 · column
Each grid row covers one row of K: 64 values in 8 pieces, one piece per thread.
so thread 19 copies the 4th piece of row 2

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: 8 bf16 values × 2 bytes = 16 bytes, one copy instruction
One step: 16 rows × (8 threads × 8 values) = 16 rows × 64 values.
The tile has 64 rows, so CuTe repeats the step 4 times:
thread 19 also copies values 24–31 of rows 18, 34 and 50.
